public_upstream.fix_subject: avfilter/vf_quirc: resize the quirc buffers when the input size changes

oh_source.l4_evidence: OH vf_quirc.c has quirc_resize only in config_input (initial size); filter_frame copies into the quirc buffer with no dimension-change check and QuircContext carries no width/height fields — the exact pre-fix structure upstream 4da9812 changed

vulnerability.summary: vf_quirc filter: a crafted PGS/SUP subtitle whose later frames have dimensions differing from the configured input writes out of bounds of the quirc buffer allocated for the first frame's size (heap OOB write).
vulnerability.trigger: feed a subtitle stream with mismatched frame dimensions through the quirc filter
vulnerability.verification_level: runtime-verified 2x3 matrix (2026-09-21, WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04, clang 18.1.3 + ASan/UBSan): original build linkgrow -> heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 512 into the 4096-byte (64x64) quirc_resize allocation, write site filter_frame vf_quirc.c:102, exit 1; patched (4da9812e applied clean) linkgrow -> CASE_DONE exit 0; control/trigger identical on both builds (no regression). PoC uses public libavfilter API only
